selection: wide scope, lower offered mixed pressure than prior failure; both arms have 200s and equal confirmed PATCH counts in exploration; priority head, then developer. Chosen once from six exploratory cells; no pilot reused.
scope: independent holdout of the frozen synthetic boundary profile only; no general performance or acceptance gate
power: six symmetric pairs is a bounded confirmation effort, not exact power or assigned threshold; wide intervals remain inconclusive
order: 3 AB and 3 BA, alternating in given chronological pair order
primary: paired B1−A change of HTTP 200 inside the window divided by all offered GET
secondary: GET 200 including drain divided by offered
COMMIT count and timing in both arms
reported_interval: exact 729 stratified bootstrap resamples of paired deltas with nearest-rank 2.5th/97.5th percentiles; each unit is a pair; no pooling by requests
analysis_stop: stop on safety failure; no early stop for preferred outcomes. No partial pair substitution or repeated failed tests; preserve rejected receipts and report inconclusive when incomplete.
direction_diagnostic: report consistency including AB and BA means, pair signs and interval, separate stability facts from owner approval; no significance/test reach threshold contingent on outcome.
